---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

career_hr <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarise(career_hr = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(career_hr)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15)

player_seasons <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarise(
    first_year = min(yearID, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year = max(yearID, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sluggers <- career_hr |>
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |>
  left_join(player_seasons, by = "playerID") |>
  mutate(
    full_name = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    seasons = paste(first_year, last_year, sep = "-"),
    full_name = forcats::fct_reorder(full_name, career_hr),
    steroid_era = last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009
  ) |>
  select(
    Player = full_name,
    `Career home runs` = career_hr,
    `Seasons` = seasons,
    `Steroid era active` = steroid_era
  )

sluggers |>
  ggplot(aes(x = `Career home runs`, y = Player, fill = `Steroid era active`)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "steelblue", "FALSE" = "gray60"),
    labels = c("Active in 1994-2009", "Not active in 1994-2009")
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, NA)) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 15 career home run leaders by steroid-era overlap",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = "Player",
    fill = "Steroid era status",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| message: false
barry <- Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarise(home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  rename(season = yearID)

barry |>
  ggplot(aes(x = season, y = home_runs)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds' home runs by season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
